page.layout: One column of running text in the centre of the left printed page. One marginal note in the left margin, beside the word "alibi". Page number "108" and running head "ANTIDOTUM" with "Cap. 12." at the top. No catchword or signature. The right edge shows part of the neighbouring page, which is left out.

main_text.p: Agedum igitur, prodeat in medium portentum illud vestrum, scilicet Meritum de Condigno. Est (inquiunt, supra, cap. 2.) libera actio in aequalitate justitiæ consistens, cui ex condignitate operis vita æterna debetur apud Deum. Nunc S. Augustinum arbitrum ad-vocamus. I. Vocat ille quidem opera-tionem bonorum justitiam; sed justitiam quæ est Gratia Dei, quia non ex te. Secunda ex priori consequitur in hunc modum: Quam-vis vita æterna sit Stipendium, sed tibi Gratia est, inquit, cui tanquam debita redderetur, si ex te esset justitia cui deberetur. Tale igitur sti-pendium vocat vitam æternam, quam conclu-dit non reddi operantibus ex debito; δὶς διὰ ταῦτ[?] diffidens à Merito de Condigno, cui (ex Pon-tificiorum definitione) vita æterna debetur, idque ex æqualitate justitia; à quo sensu Au-gustinus totus abhorruit. Propterea sub Sacramento juramenti liceret pio Lectori pro-nunciare, Augustinianum stipendium non red-di ex Merito de Condigno: Sed præcipuè, quòd alibi {*}Augustinus sese explicans ait, Cùm pos-sit [Apostolus] rectè dicere, STIPENDIUM AUTEM JUSTITIÆ EST VITA ÆTER-NA, maluit dicere, GRATIA AUTEM DEI EST VITA ÆTERNA: ut intelligeremus Deum non pro meritis nostris nos ad vi-tam æternam, sed pro sua miseratione perducere. Cùm Pontificii, si suæ definitioni constare velint,De Gratia & libero Arbitrio cap. 9.

page.notes: Running head "Cap. 12." is a chapter number and is left out of the running head. Mark "*" after "alibi" in the text and the margin note both read as an asterisk. Greek "δὶς διὰ ταῦτ" is uncertain at its end and the initial letters are doubtful; marked [?]. The faint word "Agedum" near the foot of the page is show-through from the other side and is left out. The right edge of the neighbouring page is left out. The final line "velint," is text, not a catchword, because it completes the sentence.
